Name: Island Expansion
Author: ResoNight46
Description:
[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Install the latest versions of:
    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25055]Secret Note Framework[/url][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47699]Golden Walnut Framework[/url][/color][/size]
- Download Island Expansion
- Unzip all of them and put them into your Mods folder

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Expands the Ginger Island by adding new Maps and changing minor things about the Island. Adds 100 new Custom Walnuts and Parrot Upgrade Perches. Adds two new Maps and revived an unused vanilla Map. Also adds a Ginger Island style Farming Island that you can build on (needs a while to unlock).[/color]

[img]https://mistyspring.neocities.org/Files/Titles/what-this-mod-adds.png[/img]
[list]
[*]100 new Golden Walnuts[/*]
[*]9 new Parrot Upgrade Perches[/*]
[*]2 new locations[/*]
[*]new farming area where you can place buildings[/*]
[*]revival of Island Secret (unused vanilla map)[/*]
[*]changed several things about the existing Ginger Island (for example moved Birdie to a new location)[/*]
[*]1 new Fish[/*]
[*]1 new Stone[/*]
[*]1 new Flower[/*]
[*]1 new enemy loot[/*]
[*]and more minor things[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires the following mods:[/color]
    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]
    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25055]Secret Note Framework[/url]
    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47699]Golden Walnut Framework[/url]

[b][size=4]Mod Compatibility[/size][/b]
Should be functionally compatible with almost every mod. For Birdie related mods, you can now open the config.json file and change:
[code]"MoveBirdieToMoonscytheIsland": true[/code]to false, so that birdie is sitting at her normal location.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
Incompatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42648]Ginger Island Extra Locations - Redux[/url] due to overlapping map areas


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Huge thanks to all the very helpful people on the Stardew Valley Discord server[/color][/size]
